title: CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – EXISTING LITIGATION
text:
[O. Closed Session]
CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – EXISTING LITIGATION
  (Section 54956.9(d)(1) of the California Government Code)

  Anthony D. Pacheco v. Los Angeles Department of Water and Power;
  COLA; Villareal, Los Angeles Superior Court Case No. 24STCV17279.

The Board shall publicly report any action taken in closed session and the vote or
abstention of every member present thereon, in accordance with Section 54957.1 of the
California Government Code.
